definition: Open means publicly downloadable model weights under any license, including restricted research or community licenses; this is not a claim of OSI-approved open source.
classification_time_basis: Status at review, not status at API launch. Model lifetime measures the historical ranked series of models confirmed open by the review date. Unless open_weights_since is known, no claim is made that a model was open throughout its history.
identity_policy: Exact OpenRouter model_permaslug, including dated versions and :free/:beta/:extended variants. Catalog id/canonical_slug links and explicit historical model pages are evidence, not permission to pool separate usage rows.
methods: Current catalog exact id/canonical_slug with hugging_face_id provides catalog-level openness evidence, subject to explicit primary-source overrides. A link can be a placeholder for a promised release; current leading models received primary-card checks. Missing hugging_face_id alone never establishes closed status.
Archived 2026-10-19 catalog retains mappings for since-delisted models.
Historical exact OpenRouter pages with Model weights links and targeted primary model-card checks recover disappeared models.
Known proprietary API product lines are marked closed. Ambiguous versions, stealth aliases, and unmatched releases are unknown.
IAPS-AI open/closed registry informed targeted review only; its blanket base-model merging and retroactive openness classifications are not inherited.
Open-weight release dates are left null when unverified. Catalog created timestamps are API listing dates, not weight-release dates.
